# OneUptime

> > OneUptime is an open-source observability platform providing real-time monitoring, incident management, status pages, and APM for enterprises and startups.

OneUptime consolidates monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, and incident response into a single unified platform with OpenTelemetry support and Kubernetes-native observability. The platform serves as a comprehensive alternative to fragmented observability stacks, offering features from uptime monitoring to distributed tracing with AI-powered insights.

## Key Topics

- Real-time Monitoring
- Incident Management
- OpenTelemetry
- Distributed Tracing
- Log Management
- Status Pages
- On-Call Scheduling
- Kubernetes Observability
- Exception Tracking
- Alerting & Notifications
- Metrics & Performance
- Workflow Automation
- Observability Platform
- Uptime Monitoring
- Infrastructure Monitoring

## Core Observability Features

- [Monitor any resource in real-time](https://oneuptime.com/product/monitoring): Real-time monitoring for websites, APIs, servers with global coverage and multi-channel alerts.
- [Distributed Tracing - End-to-End Request Visibility](https://oneuptime.com/product/traces): Distributed tracing across microservices with OpenTelemetry for performance optimization.
- [Fastest log ingest and search on the planet](https://oneuptime.com/product/logs-management): High-speed log ingestion and search powered by Ceph and Clickhouse with OpenTelemetry support.
- [Metrics - Performance Insights & Real-time Monitoring](https://oneuptime.com/product/metrics): Monitor application and infrastructure metrics with Prometheus compatibility and anomaly detection.
- [Exception Tracking - Catch, Fix, and Prevent Bugs](https://oneuptime.com/product/exceptions): Exception tracking with stack traces, intelligent grouping, and AI-powered root cause analysis.

## Incident & Alert Management

- [Incident Management and Response](https://oneuptime.com/product/incident-management): Streamline incident response with timelines, collaboration, and postmortems via Slack/Teams.
- [On-Call Policies and Alerts](https://oneuptime.com/product/on-call): On-call scheduling with rotations, escalations, and multi-channel alerts; PagerDuty alternative.
- [Integrate with any software or service with workflows](https://oneuptime.com/product/workflows): Workflow automation with no-code builder for incident response and third-party integrations.

## Status & Communication

- [Free Status Page | Public & Private | Unlimited Subscribers](https://oneuptime.com/product/status-page): Free status pages with unlimited subscribers, custom domains, and automatic monitoring updates.
- [Scheduled Maintenance - Plan & Communicate Downtime](https://oneuptime.com/product/scheduled-maintenance): Plan and communicate maintenance windows with automatic subscriber notifications and status updates.

## Infrastructure & Kubernetes

- [Kubernetes Observability - Monitor Clusters, Pods & Nodes](https://oneuptime.com/product/kubernetes): Complete Kubernetes observability with cluster monitoring, pod health, and OpenTelemetry native.
- [Dashboards - Visualize All Your Data in One Place](https://oneuptime.com/product/dashboards): Custom dashboards with drag-and-drop builder for metrics, logs, traces, and status data.
- [AI Agent - Automatically Fix Code Issues](https://oneuptime.com/product/ai-agent): AI agent automatically fixes errors and performance issues with pull request generation.

## Documentation & API

- [Getting Started - OneUptime Docs](https://oneuptime.com/docs): Complete documentation covering monitoring, alerts, incidents, and observability setup.
- [OneUptime API Reference - Introduction](https://oneuptime.com/reference): REST API reference for OneUptime incident management, monitoring, and status pages.

## Pricing & Enterprise

- [Request Demo | OneUptime](https://oneuptime.com/enterprise/demo): Schedule personalized demo of OneUptime's observability platform for enterprises.
